summary: Batch 6 UI QA 'My Performance' (9 screens) at 390x844 as forest@imosapp.com. All 9 screens render the shared ScreenHeader with correct testids, correct titles, working back chevron testids, and expected interactive testids. Gold theming verified, no leftover primary iOS-blue on nav/pills/primary buttons on any of the 9 screens. GEO guide-link bug fix verified (now routes to /geo-guide). Team Sales rep row navigation verified (routes to /sales-list?...rep_id=...). VA modal opens/closes with all inputs. Schedule panel + presets + email input on Activity Reports work. Email Analytics eyebrows and stat cards render. One content-level em-dash regression found on /geo-health tips text (6 occurrences).

issues: Six GEO 'Tips to improve' factor descriptions contain em dashes ('—'), e.g. 'Share your digital card more — each share creates a crawlable, AI-readable page', 'Add 5 more contacts this month — new relationships signal an active practitioner', 'Send more messages — AI engines detect active, engaged professionals', 'Add your dealership’s website — a verified employer domain is a top AI trust signal', 'Add your Google/DealerRater review link — external review platforms validate your existence', 'Link your store profile — employer association is a major AI trust signal'. Batch-6 spec forbids em dashes in visible text. Source likely /app/backend/routers/geo.py tip strings (SEO tip strings are clean). Replace — with a hyphen '-', colon ':', or period.

1 tiny empty <div> per page still has backgroundColor rgb(0,122,255) (iOS blue) with no testid/text. Likely a chart-legend color swatch (Referrals / SMS) which is allowed by spec, but flagging so main agent can confirm it is intentionally a chart category color and not a leftover primary.

Header share icon (seo-share-header-btn) opens the share sheet, but the modal's Cancel/close control does not appear to expose a data-testid like 'close-share-modal' (found by visible 'Cancel' text only). Consider adding a testid on the cancel/close control for testability. Non-blocking.

action_items: Replace em-dash characters (—) in GEO health tip strings on /geo-health with hyphens/colons to satisfy batch-6 'no em dashes' rule (SEO tip strings are already clean).
Optional: add a data-testid (e.g. close-share-modal) on the SEO/GEO share modal cancel/close control for automated coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Content parity: SEO health tip strings were updated to remove em dashes but GEO health tip strings still contain them - keep the two shared-content sets consistent in their em-dash policy.
